title: Fwd Cargo Door Surround Fitting and Inboard Frame — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: Installation of the forward cargo door surround fitting kit and the inboard surround frame sub-assembly, with the wet sealing sequence, the torque pattern and the water flow check of the escape route.

sections.purpose: This task installs the door surround fitting kit and the inboard surround frame sub-assembly at the forward cargo door and proves that the water escape route behind the frame feet is clear afterwards.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task after the removal task and after any blend-out is complete and re-protected. The sealant has a limited application life once mixed; do not mix until the parts are laid out and the fastener set is counted. Two persons are needed. The water flow check needs the aircraft approximately level, so plan the task around any jacking activity.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the frame foot and the skin land are clean, dry and correctly protected. 2. Apply the chromate-free primer to all new surfaces and let it cure for the time given in the standard practice. CAUTION: DO NOT APPLY SEALANT BEFORE THE PRIMER IS FULLY CURED. 3. Mix the polysulphide sealant and apply it to the faying surfaces of the inboard frame sub-assembly D5321134517524. Keep the interrupted land at the lowest point of each foot free of sealant. 4. Lift the frame sub-assembly into position with the sling and put four fasteners in at the corners. 5. Install the remaining fasteners and the plain washers AGS46790-6A. 6. Torque the frame sub-assembly fasteners in the sequence and to the value given in the torque table. 7. Apply sealant to the faying surfaces of the surround fitting kit D5321131361369 and install it. 8. Install the fastener set with washers AES963502K7 and EN736536-59 and torque in the given sequence. 9. Remove the sealant that has squeezed out and form a fillet at the visible edges. WARNING: DO NOT USE A SOLVENT ON A CURED FILLET. 10. Let the sealant cure. 11. Do the water flow check with the test rig and make sure that water leaves the escape route at the stringer 46 drain. 12. Install the sill closing panel and connect the harness. 13. Install the lower shell lining panels.
sections.close_out: Do the forward cargo door operational test and check that the door closes and locks with no abnormal indication. Remove the door safety struts and the warning notices. Record the installation, the torque values and the result of the water flow check in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; the interrupted sealing land applies to post MOD-130120 parts only

safety_precautions: Install the door safety struts before any person goes under the door.
Use eye protection when the sealant is mixed.
Make sure that the compartment is ventilated during primer cure.
